result.stdout:
usage: mudmcp <command> [arguments] [options]

commands:
  help [command]  Show help for the CLI or a command
  index-status  Show cached index status
  index  Build or rebuild the cached index for a version
  component <name>  Show component details
  props <name>  Show component parameters
  events <name>  Show component events
  methods <name>  Show component methods
  examples <name>  Show component examples
  example <name> <example-name...>  Show a named component example
  api <type>  Show a type's API reference
  enum <name>  Show enum values
  related <name>  Show related components
  search <query...>  Search the component catalog
  list  List components by category
  categories  List component categories and counts

global options:
  --version X.Y.Z
  --data-path <dir>
  --format compact|markdown|json

formats: compact (default), markdown, json

exit codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 not indexed, 4 not found, 130 cancelled

MCP server: mudmcp --stdio or mudmcp --http, with --version X.Y.Z or MUDBLAZOR_VERSION
